title: Revise parallel-jobs design to address review 2 changes N1-N6
summary: Edit docs/design/parallel-jobs.md only, applying each change in section 4 of review 2 (N1 landing queue first, then N2–N6) so the design can reach "accept". No code; the build is a later job.

defaults_applied.how: Design revised with alternatives before the build.
Claims about current child behavior cite files read.

assumptions: Section 4 of review 2 prescribes concrete edits; I did not read it in full, so exact wording follows that section.
The design doc may carry a status note that should be updated to reflect review 2.

acceptance_criteria.text: The landing-queue section is revised so the launcher's queue matches what child jobs actually do, resolving N1 as review 2 section 4 specifies, and it is settled before N2–N6.
Rule 1 of section 9 is changed per N2 so it fits how change jobs are written today.
Child result classification no longer relies on message text and handles reread JSON lacking a state field, as N3 requires.
The open-pull-request exit code matches the single-job command (N4).
The default for --all is changed or justified per N5 so it does not buy work the design expects to go stale.
The field holding declared paths is named explicitly (N6), matching the real field name in the repository.
Only design docs change; no code, governance files, or records/ are touched, and claims about current behavior cite sources.
